name: Core Unlocks — dormant stock gear, clean enable wire
author: MC2 remaster examples
description: Re-surfaces two dormant stock weapons for purchase — the Clan Gauss Rifle (113) and the ER PPC (146) — via the clean enabled->purchase wire (EQUIP-ENABLE-WIRE-1): each ships a tiny data/defs/equipment/core/<slug>/equipmentdef.fit override carrying only [Equipment] b Enabled=TRUE + the key-checked LegacyMasterId. The engine's availability seam (gate MC2_UNIT_PROFILE_DATA=1) forces them purchasable in every mission's mechlab; enable-only, so the mission purchase.fit stays authoritative for everything else. No whole-file compbas.csv override needed anymore.
